scope: R02 one-piece captured PTFE sleeve, bearing shoulder, guard wall and outward lip. Local concept only; not released manufacture or RF qualification.
metal_screw: M3x35 study, 5.5mm nominal entry into source spacer including chamfer.
retention: Metal head bears directly on integral PTFE shoulder; shoulder seats on grounded pocket floor. No guard retention thread.
limits: PTFE creep, preload, local stress, thermal fits, full-assembly clearance and RF insulation remain to verify. Open tool-access end shown; no cap or arc-free performance claimed.
installation: Sleeve and cup insert through existing proposed bores from the head side; larger outward lip stays outside the hole. Integral shoulder is captured by metal head.
